item.title: Birds battling jet lag: Manx shearwaters suffer jet lag impacting homeward flights; could lead to serious consequences for inexperienced navigators
item.description: Recent research highlights that Manx shearwaters returning from foraging encounters navigational challenges akin to human jet lag. Prolonged flights disrupt their internal clocks, causing misalignment with the local time, which results in notable directional inaccuracies, particularly among novice birds. Analysis of two decades of GPS data from over 1,000 nesting shearwaters underscores these findings. Further investigation is required to assess how this temporal discrepancy may affect additional behaviors. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Archaeologists digging in Beijing have found the first Great Wall remains from the Sui dynasty
item.description: Recent archaeological discoveries in Beijing have unearthed remnants of the Great Wall from the Sui Dynasty, revolutionizing our understanding of its historical context. This find emphasizes the wall's role as a military outpost on the northern frontier. Additionally, three ancient wooden boats, dating back approximately 1,800 years, were recovered in Fengtai district, showcasing an early transport network in Beijing and shedding light on the area's trade and defense roles. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
